name: NY-14
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+19 district partisan lean with a well-known incumbent seeking reelection
Massive financial advantage: $32.6M raised and $16M on hand versus $343K for the Republican
Prediction markets price the Democrat at roughly 96%
No public polling, but no evidence of a competitive race
model.rationale: Ocasio-Cortez combines a heavily Democratic district, incumbency, and an overwhelming fundraising edge against a little-funded challenger, while markets price her near-certain to win. Nothing in the evidence suggests movement away from the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: Any sign of a serious, well-funded challenger campaign or unexpected polling showing a much tighter race would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez seeks reelection in a New York City district that leans Democratic by about nineteen points. She is a nationally prominent incumbent who has raised more than $32 million and holds over $15 million in cash, while Republican Diamant Hysenaj has raised under $350,000 with minimal cash remaining. No outside groups are spending against her, and prediction markets give her roughly a 96% chance of winning.

No public general-election polling exists for this race, so the forecast rests on the district's partisan lean, incumbency, and the lopsided resource gap. All signs point to a comfortable Democratic win, with the main uncertainty being the exact size of the margin rather than the outcome.
